card.name: Drug name and 'tablets' in warnings
card.fires_on: The word 'tablets' right after a drug name, or the opening piece of a drug name, in instructions to stop, avoid or adjust a drug. It marks a point where the drug name is repeated mid-sentence.

modes.label: Tablets after drug name
modes.description: The word 'tablets' following a named drug in a discontinue or use instruction.
modes.example: discontinue naproxen<< tablets>> or naproxen sodium tablets immediately,

modes.label: Start of a drug name
modes.description: An early piece of a drug name that is only partly written, such as ery, irt, paz or hydro.
modes.example: reduce the dose of<< paz>>opanib tablets.

card.plain: It lights up when a warning names a drug again, either on the word 'tablets' or in the first part of the drug's name.
